# Test fixture provenance

- `schema_valid_empty.csv` — synthetic header row only (no data rows); created for empty-valid parse tests.
- `schema_drift.csv` — synthetic; required column `referenceNumber-numeroReference` removed.
- `parse_rejected_rows.csv` — synthetic CanadaBuys-shaped rows that all fail at parse time (named for what it proves: parse-level rejection leaving a trace. Renamed 2026-10-13 from `all_rows_rejected.csv`, which overclaimed the sampler's `all-rows-rejected` stratum — that stratum is proven by `no_funding_row.csv`).
- `issued_by_bait.txt` — synthetic one-line HTML-ish text for deadline regression (not a network capture).
- `canadabuys-ideas-live-2026-10-14.html` — REAL network capture, not synthetic. URL: `https://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/tender-opportunities?keywords=IDEaS`; fetched 2026-10-14T01:49:33Z; HTTP 200; 416,046 bytes; SHA-256 `e44a13338b6b1a764b21eda4caab97ca07635bbe686c59f1d62eda9c4a87e996`. Fetch method: plain urllib with the project User-Agent — the project's guarded fetch path was blocked at DNS on the capture VM (NetGuardError: this VM resolves public hosts to 198.18.0.0/15 egress-interception addresses, which the guard rejects); the capture is byte-identical to what the server sent (hash above). Captured for GitHub issue #2 (IDEaS HTML coverage): the page's only `<article>` elements are footer "useful links" blocks, and its results are body links.
- `program_page_no_article.html` — synthetic. Derived from the canada.ca WET program-page shape (header/nav/main/footer chrome, h1 page title, h2/h3 content sections, no `<article>` element) — the shape DESIGN-v2 §3 names as the primary source. Card content patterns (component labels, funding figures, closing-date phrasing) follow `sample_opportunity.html`. Not a network capture: www.canada.ca returned zero bytes from the capture VM at 15s, 25s, and 60s budgets (2026-10-14), so no real program-page fixture could be taken. **Derivation verified against the live page on 2026-10-13 via browser:** the real IDEaS program page (defence-ideas.html) loads fine in a browser and its `<main>` contains zero `<article>` elements — content is `<section>`/`<div>` blocks under h2/h3 headings ("What is IDEaS?", "Featured opportunities", "What does the IDEaS program provide?" with h3 element cards), matching this fixture's shape. The script-egress block is specific to this VM (urllib/curl time out; the browser loads instantly). A full opportunities listing also exists at `programs/defence-ideas/opportunities.html` (verified loaded in browser, 14 pages of challenges) — a candidate source once a raw capture exists from an unintercepted network.
- `nested_articles.html` — synthetic. Standard HTML5 shape: an `<article>` containing a nested `<article>`, plus sibling multi-section articles with no `data-id`. Built to prove depth-aware article extraction and per-article section-id uniqueness.

Reference rows with real CanadaBuys field shapes are read from repo-root
`source-evidence/canadabuys-reference.csv` (read-only evidence; not copied here).
